title: Cursed (status group)
html:
This article is about the group of conditions. For other uses, see Cursed (disambiguation).

Cursed is a status group. It is a group of magical conditions that hinder or harm during combat.

Removal

The following items remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Noblestalk

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Remove Curse
  • Greater Restoration

Immunity

The following items grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Khalid's Gift

List of conditions in Cursed

Condition Effects
A Clown in Town
  • Rue the day you crossed a fey. You were cruel to Dolly Thrice; now you'll have to pay the price.
  • This condition can only be obtained by smashing the Moonlantern held by Kar'niss.
  • Applies clown makeup to the victim.
Baleful Knowledge
  • Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Broken Promises
  • Strength is increased by 2 until the next Long Rest.
  • Upon resting, Strength is indefinitely reduced by 1.
Castigated By Divinity
  • Affected entity is cursed by transgressed and irritable gods. When it falls unconscious, it immediately dies. Moreover, when it dies, a terrible envoy of the offended deity is conjured from the entity's corpse.
Cheater's Folly
  • Affected entity has all Ability Scores reduced by 1 for attacking a reflection that's not their own. This effect can be applied thrice more.
Curse of Regret
  • Takes 1d4+1⁠⁠Psychic every turn, and is vulnerable to Psychic damage. Deal damage to remove this condition.
Curse of the Sired
  • Cursed by a victim he brought to Cazador many years ago, Astarion receives  Disadvantage on all  Saving Throws.
Cursed Skull
  • This skull is cursed with necromantic powers that shoots thunderwaves.
Cursed: Additional Damage
  • Receives an additional 1d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster's attacks or spells.
Cursed: Attack Disadvantage
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against the source of the curse.
Cursed: Charisma
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
Cursed: Constitution
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Constitution.
Cursed: Dexterity
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Dexterity.
Cursed: Dread
  • Each turn, the affected entity has to succeed on a Wisdom  Saving Throw or skip its turn.
Cursed: Filled with Dread
  • Gave in to the dread bestowed upon it by its curse, and can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.
Cursed: Intelligence
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Intelligence.
Cursed: Strength
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
Cursed: Wisdom
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Wisdom.
Faltering Will
  •  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks until Long Rest.
Haunting Aura
  • Nearby creatures are afflicted with  Phantasmal Force.
Hellfire Curse
  • Hellfire roiling within this creature gives it  Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws.
Hexed: Charisma
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.
Hexed: Constitution
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.
Hexed: Dexterity
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.
Hexed: Intelligence
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.
Hexed: Strength
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks.
Hexed: Wisdom
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Insanity's Kiss
  • Hostile to all other creatures for the condition's duration.
Life Drain

Hit point maximum reduced by 2d8. Creature will die if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

Lost Time
  • Armour Class is reduced by 2. Can't take Reactions.
Lover's Avarice
  • Wisdom is indefinitely reduced by 1.
Mummy Rot
  • Your maximum hit points are reduced by 8. You cannot be healed.
Mystic Carrion's Blinding Curse
  • Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned and  Blinded.
  • It must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw at the end of its turn or become afflicted with  Mystic Carrion's Restraining Curse and receive 4d10⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Mystic Carrion's Poisoned Curse
  • Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned.
  • It must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw at the end of its turn or become afflicted by  Mystic Carrion's Blinding Curse and receive 2d10⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Mystic Carrion's Restraining Curse
  • Affected entity has been cursed by Mystic Carrion. It is  Poisoned,  Blinded,  Restrained, and receives ⁠Necrotic damage.
  • Receives 6d10⁠⁠Necrotic damage on a failed  Spell Save DC Constitution Saving Throw each turn.
Sapping Curse

This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer.

  • Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Target is cursed.
Shadow Possession
  • Affected entity is possessed by frenzied shadows and will attack the nearest creature. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Shar-Stricken
  • The Lady of Loss  Hexes you, causing a temporary lapse in your agility.
Shrouded
  • This painting is obscured while within 6 m (20 ft) of the Judge.
Shrouded Sentence
  • The Judge is obscuring paintings within 6 m (20 ft), preventing judgement being passed on an accused soul.
Sinister Seal
  • Dark energy envelops this door.
Soulnumbed
  • Can't take  Bonus Actions or  Reactions.
Spell Rot
  • Unless you are Undead, each time you cast a spell you receive 2d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage per spell level.
Stolen Vigour
  • Your chosen ability score is reduced by 2.
Strength Drain
  • A shadow has drained the affected entity's Strength by 3.
Tharchiate Withering
  • Your Constitution score is reduced by 5 while cursed by The Tharchiate Codex's warped arcana.
Tyrannical Curse
  • Bane's fist will fall at the end of the affected entity's next turn unless the curse is removed, dealing 20d10⁠⁠Force to the target area and giving nearby Banites  Tyrant's Edict.
Whispers of Madness
  • Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Wilted Dreams
  • The target takes 3d6⁠⁠Psychic damage during next Long Rest.
